title: Starting point
description: Per capita income US$453; extreme poverty 36%; maternal mortality 750 per 100,000; life expectancy 51 years.

title: Lower-middle-income status
description: Tanzania attains lower-middle-income status in July 2020.

title: Latest measured baseline
description: Per capita income about US$1,277 (2023); extreme poverty 26%; primary enrolment 98%; manufactured exports US$1.4bn.

title: Julius Nyerere Hydropower
description: The Julius Nyerere Hydropower Project adds 2,115 MW to the national grid.

title: Dira 2050 adopted
description: The Tanzania Development Vision 2050 is launched, setting the 25-year national direction guided by a 25-year Long-Term Perspective Plan (LTPP).

title: The Tanzania we want
description: One-trillion-dollar economy, US$7,000 per capita, upper-middle-income status, 118m+ people, high quality of life for all.
